source.title: [APPLY][CN-ENG][STRETCH] 小红书 — AI Agent 全栈工程师（采购方向）— 社招 21635
source.body:
# Decision — APPLY / NOT SUBMITTED (2026-11-12)

**Battlefield:** CN-ENG (main priority). **Fit tier:** ACCEPTABLE ADJACENT, with real development of business Agent systems; strong Chinese technology employer but practical procurement domain rather than core NLP research. **Application is NOT submitted and no employer contact performed.**

## Official role and route
- Employer: 小红书 / Xiaohongshu, social recruitment (社招), Shanghai, China.
- Exact role: **AI Agent 全栈工程师（采购方向）**. Official role ID **21635**.
- First-party exact employer-hosted role and intended native application route: https://job.xiaohongshu.com/social/position/21635 . The employer-indexed full job text was visible from this URL in Nov 2026; direct site responds with a client-rendered page, so final **signed-in application form / whether still accepting at click time remains UNVERIFIED**. Open and check before final submission. This is *not* an MCF route.
- **Source:** original official Xiaohongshu careers page, social-hiring tier 1. The external index was crawled ~2 weeks before 2026-11-12; no original role deadline or explicit headcount was exposed. This is a dated visibility caveat, not proof that slots are currently unfilled.
- **Employment:** social-hire standard role, **PROBABLE** regular employment (contract term not explicitly published). Foreign-work-permit support **UNKNOWN**; Malaysian national needs employer assistance for CN permit, and absence of a ban is not proof of support.

## Actual employer-authored work
- Design and develop **real procurement/business AI agents** spanning demand analysis, sourcing strategy, bid/tender process, supplier negotiation, contract review and execution workflows.
- Build **knowledge bases, datasets, Agent architectures and continuous improvement**. Account for business outcomes and workflows, not only prompt templates.
- Employer says: \"你将会进行 Agent 产品的架构设计和技术开发\"; \"你将会搭建知识库，构建数据集，并实现 Agent 的自主迭代升级\".
- Strong production application / full-stack direction, not a guarantee of dedicated LLM research or model training.

## Eligibility and truthful fit
- Employer requires **3+ years full-stack technical experience**, familiarity with Internet-company infrastructure and independent front/back development; real Agent development and demonstrable personal/open-source/hackathon Agent projects are accepted as evidence.
- Candidate has ~4 **calendar years of paid part-time** Laravel/PHP/Vue/MySQL backend/full-stack development (NOT 4 full-time-equivalent or professional production Agent years); 2026 NTHU MSc with separate Python RAG, Text-to-SQL Agent/verifier/evaluation, QLoRA and dialogue KG research. The 3+ professional experience interpretation and Internet-scale infrastructure are **major stretch** and employer may not count part-time experience as equivalent.
- Degree: MSc meets bachelor's+; no explicit mandatory PhD, publication or 2027-only cohort in indexed social JD.
- Biggest risk: strong independent full-stack ownership at Internet-company scale and business procurement domain. Prioritize over shallow service providers, but below GOLD Agent runtime/evaluation roles of comparable eligibility.

## Dedupe & evidence honesty (2026-11-12)
- Searched all open+closed GitHub Issues for exact official `21635`, full role title and procurement role variants: **no same-role Issue found** before create.
- Both connected Gmail accounts searched exact role ID, exact job title, and the procurement direction with employer: **no exact prior receipt found**. One generic saved-jobs email containing unrelated Agent roles is NOT an application.
- Other Xiaohongshu roles and applications do exist (e.g. distinct REDstar/Agent vacancies). Employer-level prior history is not a duplicate of official social-hire requisition `21635`. Before applying check the signed-in Xiaohongshu history and application limits.

## Next action
Candidate review/explicit authorization for **Xiaohongshu social role 21635** → open official role page in normal browser, verify position not `停招/下线` and native `投递简历` action is usable, confirm whether paid part-time 3+ years is eligible, disclose Malaysian work-permit status truthfully, submit through employer portal, save actual confirmation and transition to WAIT. If page shows closed/local-national-only or employer hard professional-YOE incompatibility, close BLOCKED rather than claim submission.

No email or application has been sent in this pass.
